units.en: ⟦0⟧ is used to unlock technologies. These can serve to unlock new units, equipment or structures or to improve the performance of existing units, equipment and structures.
⟦0⟧: Technologies that improve infantry weapons and equipment, unlock or improve motorized and mechanized units as well as special forces (marines, mountaineers and paratroopers).
⟦0⟧: Technologies that unlock and improve all types of artillery, including anti-tank, anti-air and rocket artillery.
⟦0⟧: Technologies that unlock and improve all types of support battalions: Engineers, Reconnaissance, Military Police, Maintenance, Field Hospital, Logistics and Signal companies.

⟦0⟧ (different ⟦1⟧): Technologies that unlock all types and models of tanks, from light to super heavy chassis, as well as their variants: tank destroyer, self-propelled artillery and self-propelled anti-air.
⟦0⟧ (different ⟦1⟧): Technologies that unlock or improve all kinds of ship units: destroyers, light and heavy cruisers, battlecruisers, battleships, carriers, and submarines.
⟦0⟧: With ⟦1⟧, the naval support research tree includes all technologies which are not direct derivatives of ship hulls. These technologies include for the most part new or improved naval weaponry.
⟦0⟧ (different ⟦1⟧): Technologies that unlock or improve all types of airframes: light, medium or heavy, as well as their jet propulsion versions.
⟦0⟧: Groups all technologies related to electronic engineering (computers, radios, cryptography), rockets, and atomic research.
⟦0⟧: Groups all technologies that improve production efficiency and volume of all ⟦1⟧, increase the excavation of resources, and unlock and improve ⟦2⟧.
Special project: All technologies that are directly unlocked by completing certain special projects.
Technology is unlocked by assigning a research slot to it for the required number of days.

Some countries are defined with the base numbers of research slots, while other European countries have 3 and non-European countries have 2 by default. In addition to the base slots, countries can unlock additional research slots via their ⟦0⟧ trees (1~3 depending on the country). For most countries, they can not complete all these focuses in a game because they belong to different branches. Some of these focuses require some conditions, like having a substantial number of factories (usually 50+), and the Commonwealth countries must additionally become fully independent to maximize their available research slots.
